title: Which member comuni of a coastal union of comuni qualify for its 2027 peak-month services co-financing on their August 2026 guest nights per resident, with the comuni's January to April 2026 guest nights, October 2025 bed-place occupancy by type and the 2025 tourist tax by quarter
subdomain: seasonal-adjustment-official-time-series-production (a monthly accommodation series whose missing returns are filled, benchmarked to the quarterly tourist-tax declarations of the same nights)
prompt_shape: other: every member comune's August 2026 nights per resident set against the 30-night line, the qualifying set and the closest comune, with three conformed side tables
stated_inputs: the co-financing line, the residents' date and the definition of guest nights (regulation arts. 2 to 4)

sources.origin: generated by task123/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional Italian coastal union of comuni, its accommodation establishments, the region's monthly guest-movement survey, the comuni's tourist-tax declarations and the regional register; every comune, organisation, establishment and person is invented, province code 112 is not a real province, and no real dataset is reproduced.
